name: Visit Essex — Win tickets to BBC Gardeners' World Autumn Fair
notes: Official Visit Essex (visitessex.com) competition, no purchase necessary. Prize: 2x VIP tickets for the winner + a guest to BBC Gardeners' World Autumn Fair, Sun 13 Sept 2026 at Audley End House and Gardens. Closes Mon 31 Aug 2026, 5pm BST. Entry form has a required free-text 'Title' field, now filled from Profile.title (added this run) — make sure that's set before this syncs, or the adapter will fail loudly on it.

name: Visit North Norfolk — Win Passes to North Norfolk Attractions
notes: Official Visit North Norfolk (visitnorthnorfolk.com) competition, no purchase necessary. Prize: family day passes (2 adults + 2 children) to 18 North Norfolk attractions (Holkham Hall, Pensthorpe, North Norfolk Railway, Amazona Zoo, etc), usable Sept 2026 to 31 Oct 2027. Closes 11:59pm 31 Aug 2026. Simple form (forename/surname/email + a Yes/No 'have you visited before' question, no researched answer needed). Same NewMind/eCMS engine as visit-essex-gardeners-world. Only fields required are firstName/lastName/email, all already set.

name: Village People Magazine — Win a wild family adventure (Banham Zoo & Africa Alive)
notes: Village People Magazine (village-people.info), a genuine Norfolk/Suffolk regional print magazine, no purchase necessary. Prize: family tickets (2 adults + 3 children) to Banham Zoo (Norfolk) or Africa Alive (Suffolk). Closes 3 Sept 2026. Contact Form 7 form requires full name, a single free-text address, phone, and email — profile needs addressLine1/city/postalCode and phone set, or the adapter will fail loudly. The page hosts several unrelated Village People competitions on separate forms; this adapter targets only the Banham Zoo/Africa Alive form specifically (wpcf7 id 103083).

name: Coast Magazine — Win a Unique Break on the Suffolk Coast
notes: Coast Magazine (Kelsey Media), created with The Suffolk Coast tourism board, no purchase necessary. Prize: 2-night stay at The Crown and Castle, Orford, private Orford Ness tour, £100 Snape Maltings voucher. Closes midnight 31 Aug 2026. Entry is on a separate domain (coast.kelseydirect.com) behind Cloudflare bot-management — the adapter navigates straight there and fails loudly if a Cloudflare challenge page appears instead of the form; worth checking the first real run for that. Quiz question ('who looks after Orford Ness') answered National Trust — verified independently, not guessed. Only fields required are firstName/lastName/email/postalCode, all already set; phone is optional.

name: Devon's Top Attractions — Win A Devon Holiday, Free Days Out & other Prizes 2026
notes: Official Devon's Top Attractions (devonstopattractions.co.uk) competition, run by the Association of Devon Attractions — a genuine regional tourism consortium of real Devon attractions (Bovey Castle, Buckfast Abbey, Crealy, etc), same kind of organisation as the already-tracked north-norfolk-attractions. No purchase necessary. Prize: one of nine Devon prizes (camping trip, lodge break, castle stay, spa day, tram driving lesson, theme park passes, coastal cruise, etc). Closes 31 Aug 2026. Gravity Forms with invisible reCAPTCHA v3 (not solved/evaded, just submitted normally) — only name/email required, county/phone optional. Note: this session's own sandbox couldn't complete a live Playwright render of this domain (Chromium got net::ERR_CONNECTION_RESET even on already-working sites like thesuffolkcoast.co.uk once routed through this environment's mandatory egress proxy) — that's a sandbox networking artifact, not a site-side bot block; curl fetched the real page and its Gravity Forms markup cleanly with no anti-automation JS. Worth double-checking the very first live run actually reaches the form rather than assuming this is fine.

name: c2c — The Blowout Company: Win a stylish makeover
notes: Official c2c (Trenitalia c2c Limited, c2c-online.co.uk) competition — c2c is the train operator running Essex Thameside services (London Fenchurch Street to Southend/Shoeburyness), i.e. directly relevant to this profile's location. No purchase necessary — entry is via the form alone; a c2c account only doubles the entry (not required). Prize: a blow-dry, glass of Prosecco, manicure, plus complimentary c2c travel. Closes 11:59am 9 Sept 2026 (converted from the site's displayed 11:59am BST). Minimal Gravity Forms form: first/last name + email only, no marketing checkbox on the form itself. Same 'sandbox couldn't render live, curl confirmed the real form is clean' caveat as devons-top-attractions above — same underlying environment issue, not evidence of a genuine site block.
